agent.reasons: Kofi Fofana is the control person and the 100% indirect owner through Birch Holdings LLC, but his ID verification status is "unknown". Nothing else blocks the case: ownership is complete, the registry filing is under 12 months old, the industry is normal, both locations are US, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks came back clean. The adverse media results came without the search record that 4.4 requires.
